camera.shot_scale_bias: loose medium shots with imperfect framing

lens.focal_bias: a vintage zoom lens with soft corners
lens.dof: moderate focus that breathes slightly during the zoom

lighting.practicals: highlights bloom and clip the way film stock does

palette.grade: warm and faded, with lifted milky blacks

rules: visible film grain across the whole frame
occasional dust, hair and gate weave
composition.movement_of_subject: movement carries a slight strobing from the shutter

sound.ambience_bias: thin location sound with tape hiss and limited high frequencies

music.instrumentation: A warm analogue organ with brushed drums
music.dynamics: slightly wavering in pitch, as if from tape

must_include: heavy 16mm film grain and slight gate weave
highlights bloom softly and blacks sit milky rather than pure

notes: Grain, gate weave and faded stock. The imperfections of the medium are the style.
